name: A month of books of a Kigali trading company, VAT-registered and filing monthly

documents.why: A domestic sale at the standard rate of 18 %: box 5 and the VAT on taxable sales of box 35.
An export of goods, zero-rated under article 7(1)(a): box 5 and box 20, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
A domestic sale of minerals, zero-rated under article 7(1)(c) without the goods leaving Rwanda: box 5 and box 15.
A sale of unprocessed agricultural produce, exempt under article 8(1)(k): box 5 and box 10, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
A credit note for one unit returned from INV-001, so box 5 and box 35 fall back down and a sale_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Office furniture, retail sale — one unit returned

documents.why: A domestic purchase at the standard rate, deductible in full: box 55 and box 60, and a matched payment later on.
A passenger vehicle whose input tax is disallowed under article 20(a): the VAT becomes part of the cost of the vehicle and reaches no box.

lines.name: Passenger motor vehicle for the sales manager

documents.why: An import of goods: VAT due at the customs point under article 29(2), claimed as input tax through box 50 and box 60, and held on the customs control account until settled.

A service acquired from a supplier outside Rwanda, not available on the local market: the recipient self-charges the output tax under article 14 and claims it back through box 65, netting to nothing on a wholly taxable purchase.

A service acquired from a supplier outside Rwanda, available from an identical service on the local market: the self-charged output tax of box 40 cannot be offset under article 14(3), so it becomes part of the cost of the line.
A purchase credit note for a short delivery on PINV-001, so box 55 and box 60 fall back down and a purchase_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Trading stock purchased for resale — short-delivery credit

payments.why: The export of INV-002 collected in full: a matched inbound payment in a foreign trade relationship.
The exempt sale of INV-004 collected in full: a matched inbound payment on an exempt supply.
PINV-001 settled in full, VAT included: a matched outbound payment.
An advance received from Goma Fresh Imports SARL before its next invoice, matched to nothing: reconcile() has to survive an open item.
